reuse.why: Builds the takeover into the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount, next to its existing duplicate-link check, and shares the unlinked-field set with unlinkAccount instead of rewriting it.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated (the unlink field list is extracted and reused by unlinkAccount); the only repetition is forwarding the new flag through each of the six provider wrappers.

placement.why: The rule lives in the shared link routine in accounts/app.ts, after the closed-account check and before the account is written, where the tree keeps link preconditions.

scope.why: Flag, takeover in the shared routine, the small unlinkAccount extraction it needs, and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; the per-provider wrappers must each forward the flag by hand, so a new base parameter keeps costing six edits.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Unlinking uses the shared unlinkedAccountFields also used by unlinkAccount; all providers go through linkBankSyncAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The unlink field reset is shared via unlinkedAccountFields rather than copied.
